results.title: Batect parity (execution): the task network is removed even when a container's removal failed · Issue #309 · or1can/ratect
results.snippet: If any removal fails, the network is kept and listed among the manual cleanup commands. Ratect calls remove_network whenever it owns the network and cleanup wasn't abandoned (engine.rs:2296, if owns_network && !abandoned), whatever happened to the removals before it; each removal error is only a warn (engine.rs:2189-2205).

results.snippet: Resolved - On October 1, around 02:00 UTC, an isolated infrastructure failure caused GitHub Actions to lose execution state for a small number of existing workflow runs. Affected runs may remain stuck, fail deployment approvals, or return errors when cancelled.
